First public release of GhostChat: private, end-to-end encrypted, live 1-to-1 chat and voice calls for a family, with a hacker-terminal look.

GhostChat 首個公開版本：家人之間私密、端對端加密的即時一對一文字及語音通話，駭客終端機風格。

## Which file? / 下載哪個檔案？

| System / 系統 | File / 檔案 |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | `ghostchat_0.2.1_x64-setup.exe` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon, M1 or newer) | `GhostChat_0.2.1_aarch64-apple-darwin.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `GhostChat_0.2.1_x86_64-apple-darwin.dmg` |
| Linux | `.AppImage` or `.deb` |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksum of every file. / `SHA256SUMS.txt` 列出每個檔案的校驗碼。

## What is in it / 功能

- End-to-end encrypted text chat and file transfer (iroh, QUIC + TLS 1.3), no chat history on disk.
- Voice calls with echo cancellation and noise suppression; `/voicetest` checks your microphone and speakers.
- Pairing with 12-character invite codes (`/invite CODE`) and safety-word verification.
- 端對端加密文字及檔案傳送，磁碟上不留對話記錄；語音通話（回音消除、降噪）；邀請碼配對及安全字詞核實。

## Before you install / 安裝前須知

- The installers are **not code-signed**, so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper warn the first time. See the README for the steps. / 安裝檔沒有付費簽名，第一次會出現警告，步驟見 README。
- GhostChat 0.2 does not connect to 0.1.x: everyone you talk to needs 0.2. / 0.2 與 0.1.x 互不相容，雙方都要用 0.2。
- macOS and Linux builds have not yet been tested on real machines. / macOS 及 Linux 版本尚未在真機測試。
